rules.request: Correct the reported balance to match the dated, relevant servicer records or explain and substantiate the difference.
Investigate the contactability remark and remove or correct it if inaccurate or misleading.
Investigate whether one obligation has been inaccurately reported twice and correct any actual duplication.
Reconcile the account status and payment history against the underlying servicing records.
Investigate the absent or inconsistent closure date and correct any materially misleading account information.
Correct the specific inaccurate payment-history month(s) and associated status fields.
Investigate the identified inquiry and its permissible purpose; remove or correct it if it lacked a permissible purpose or was attributed in error.
